title: 1986 Leaf All-Star Game Pop-Up Baseball Card Dwight Gooden New York Mets
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: 1986 Leaf All-Star Game Pop-Up Baseball Card featuring Dwight Gooden of the New York Mets from the 1986 season. The card is a sports trading card part of the 1986 Leaf set, manufactured by Leaf. It is a unique pop-up card that showcases Gooden as an All-Star player in Major League Baseball (MLB). This card is not autographed and is a valuable collectible for fans of baseball and trading cards.
